blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, AGUSAN DEL SUR, Philippines — For farmer Alex Moreno, the hardest decision this planting season was not working in the field but deciding not to plant at all. Moreno, a member of the Sta. Ana Farmers Association in Barangay Sta. Ana, San Francisco, was supposed to plant rice in July and harvest by September. But the lack of water caused by the continuing El Niño phenomenon forced him to leave portions of his farmland unused. Moreno shared how the dry spell disrupted his farming plans.
